summary: MASL — Powered by Ticker: comprehensive backend + frontend test run. 18/18 backend pytest passing (all curated content endpoints + /api/talk multi-turn + terminology). Frontend Expo web preview loads cleanly, all 6 top tabs (recap/tonight/home/reels/scores/stats) switch, cold-open animates through all beats to WATCH LIVE ON VICTORY+, floating mic opens Talk and returns dual-host (Rayo+Casey) LLM replies with correct arena-soccer terminology and ZERO hockey leaks in the DOM. Minor: two React Native web deprecation warnings observed (shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents) — surface-level, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: multiple StyleSheet blocks (e.g. /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:77 mic shadow*).
React Native Web warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:52.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props with `boxShadow` and move `pointerEvents` prop into `style` on the tab body layer wrapper in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx.
No functional issues to fix. Product is demo-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py history replay for LLM context sends only prior user messages back (no assistant turns replayed) — acceptable but the assistant will not see its own prior replies; consider passing assistant turns via LlmChat messages if deeper multi-turn recall becomes important.
All endpoints correctly under /api prefix, no _id serialization issues (Mongo used only for talk_sessions with $push turns).
masl_data.py knowledge layer explicitly bans hockey terms and enumerates arena-soccer terminology — verified live against Claude Sonnet 4.6 with 3 different prompts; zero leaks.
seed_data_creation: None. Curated dataset lives in /app/backend/masl_data.py. Talk sessions written to Mongo `talk_sessions` collection during tests (safe test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). All /api/talk tests hit real Claude Sonnet 4.6 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — expect ~5-15s per call. The terminology guard in _hockey_hits() in test_masl_backend.py is the highest-priority regression: keep it. Frontend `run-the-tape` testID lives on RECAP screen, not HOME (HOME uses `cold-open-hero`).
